desc:
GET CHEESY: The Bugles Crispy Corn Snacks you know and love, in a delicious nacho cheese flavor

PANTRY AND PARTY FAVORITE: A pantry staple that's delicious alone or added to your favorite party snack mix recipes; A fun alternative to ordinary chips that's a blast to play with

PACK SOME TO GO: Perfect snack addition for the lunch box or the office snack drawer; Take some to munch on later as you head out the door

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Enjoy all kinds of creative ways to eat this delicious snack; Tasty for kids and kids at heart

CONTAINS: Six 14.5 oz Family Size bags of Bugles Nacho Cheese Crispy Corn Snacks
features:
Key Features:

Cone-shaped corn snack with a signature crispy texture.

Bold cheese flavor coating every bite for a savory snacking experience.

Made from degermed yellow corn meal, vegetable oils (including coconut and sunflower), and real cheese.

Comes in multi-ounce bags—ideal for sharing, parties, or portion-controlled snacking.

Zero trans fat and no cholesterol per serving.

Shelf-stable, with a long pantry life.

Benefits:

Fun to eat: The unique cone shape makes them perfect for dipping or just munching as-is—popular with both kids and adults.

Flavorful and crunchy: Delivers a satisfying cheese flavor and airy crunch, without the greasiness of some fried snacks.

Convenient packaging: Great for lunchboxes, travel, office snacks, or after-school treats.

Portion-friendly: Easy to control servings and share at gatherings or events.

Versatile snack: Can be used in snack mixes, party bowls, or even crushed over casseroles and salads for added crunch.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Coconut Oil and/or Palm Kernel Oil, Sugar, Maltodextrin. Contains 2 % or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Baking Soda, Dried Buttermilk, Monosodium Glutamate, Dried Whey, Reduced Lactose Whey, Dried Onion, Tomato Powder, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Dried Garlic, Citric Acid, Dried Cheddar Cheese (cultured milk, salt, enzymes), Spice, Paprika Extract, Disodium Inosinate, Disodium Guanylate, Dried Enzyme Modified Cheddar Cheese (milk, cultures, salt, enzymes), Disodium Phosphate, Artificial Color (red 40 lake, yellow 6, yellow 5). Freshness preserved by BHT.
